recent_articles.rephrased_article: On June 6th, marked the 42nd anniversary of Operation Blue Star.  **United Kingdom government documents**, declassified around 12 years ago, reveal that a British military advisor visited India in February 1984 and advised against a frontal assault strategy, suggesting an alternative approach based on surprise and helicopter insertion. **Mrs Gandhi**, the then Indian Prime Minister, approved this plan but ultimately rejected it when the Indian Army took control of the operation.  The documents also show that the UK government was concerned about potential embarrassment if their advice leaked to India, and they emphasized the importance of prior warning before military intervention.
